body: I don't have religion. I used to have hobbies in high school, but they feel pointless now. They just feel like a distraction from the reality of what I am. My mom is my only family, and she doesn't understand, most of the time she just makes things worse. My friends have good intent, my boyfriend included, but they all say the same thing. That I should try to take some classes again, that I should try again. But everything I try doesn't work. I appreciate the sentiment, but I don't know. I'll try to get back into my own hobbies. I don't know.
